Hello, I'm Wahiduz Zaman Alam.

I am a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer & Product Manager focused on architecting scalable web platforms and AI-powered mobile ecosystems. I specialize in bridging product vision with robust, end-to-end technical execution to create delightful digital experiences.

Over the years, I’ve built responsive, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, and Astro, alongside native cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and Dart. On the backend, I design heavy, scalable infrastructure using Python, Django, PostgreSQL, and Redis, deployed via containerized Docker environments.

Beyond code, I step into product management—shaping feature workflows, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and integrating modern AI capabilities to solve complex problems (most recently in the industrial quick-commerce space). I also enjoy creating architecture walkthroughs and visual guides to simplify complex workflows for both users and engineering teams.

I love building intuitive interfaces, optimizing system performance, and continuously leveraging new technologies to build platforms that make a real-world impact.
